1_protocol_gate_ordering_defect.defect: The runner performs P2 (BASE + param-free MC + w_u reader TRAINING + reader eval + recovery/harm) for ALL modes/seeds BEFORE P1c computes the 3-seed GDN stability qualification that sets H3_TESTABILITY. Pre-registration required: select seed42 candidate -> evaluate GDN BASE on all preregistered seeds -> QUALIFY or BLOCK -> only if QUALIFIED run MC/reader outcome-bearing work.
1_protocol_gate_ordering_defect.control_flow_evidence: ops/rnn_05b_ext.py run(): P2 loop lines 655-705 (reader train line 676: train(...,'grm',params=rparams...); recovery line 681: evaluate_paired(...,capture_attr=True)); stability gate lines 707-713 (band_ok -> H3_TESTABILITY QUALIFIED/BLOCKED_BY_UNSTABLE_BASE) executes AFTER the P2 loop. See source_controlflow_excerpt.txt.
1_protocol_gate_ordering_defect.note: The MC/reader recovery/harm numbers are post-stop exploratory observations, retained as real observations, not load-bearing evidence.
1_protocol_gate_ordering_defect.EXT2_hard_requirement: All load-bearing BASE qualification (all preregistered seeds) must COMPLETE and be PERSISTED before any MC/reader outcome is computed. Do NOT alter historical runner behavior to pretend the original execution used another order.

2_forgetting_vs_training_instability.defect: Calibration trains a NEW backbone independently for each challenge condition, so the observed retain/collapse cliff conflates recurrent forgetting, optimization difficulty, basin/seed sensitivity, and training stability.
2_forgetting_vs_training_instability.retract: no stable graded-forgetting regime exists for the GDN substrate
2_forgetting_vs_training_instability.interpretation: No stable intermediate-performance regime was found when INDEPENDENTLY TRAINING this toy DN/GDN family at each tested interference condition. The experiment does NOT establish that one already-trained stable GDN cannot exhibit graded forgetting as inference-time retention pressure increases.

3_snapshot_ablation_scope_defect.defect: Ablation used proximal_idx=0 and irrelevant_idx=n_snap-1 (GLOBAL early-snapshot ablation, not per-target nearest-write). In the executed run random_idx=0 (== proximal_idx) for BOTH gdn and dn (n_snap=7), so the random same-count control is a duplicate of the early ablation and provides no independent control.
3_snapshot_ablation_scope_defect.supersedes: the historical outcomes label HISTORICAL_SNAPSHOT_CAUSAL_SIGNAL=SUPPORTED (raw JSON unchanged; this note governs interpretation).
3_snapshot_ablation_scope_defect.EXT2_requirement: deterministic random control that explicitly EXCLUDES the target/proximal and irrelevant control indices; preferably a per-target or write-region-aware proximal ablation.

4_collapsed_backbone_wording.retract: a collapsed final state has no useful history to read
